C194.name: Chake Chake District
C194.documented: coastal floods, large waves, strong winds, heavy rain, and boat accidents

area.en: Chake Chake: town valleys and creek
area.sw: Chake Chake: mabonde ya mji na hori

risk.en: This area is a hilly town where storm run-off floods valley streets and the creek, and steep cuts can slide in heavy rain.
risk.sw: Eneo hili ni mji wa milimani ambapo maji ya dhoruba hufurika mitaa ya mabondeni na hori, na miinuko mikali inaweza kuporomoka wakati wa mvua kubwa.

advice.en: For those living and trading here, it helps to keep drains open and build away from valley floors and steep cuts. What raises the risk: building on the valley floors or at the foot of the cut slopes, filling the drains and the creek with waste, and cutting into the hillside for new plots. Know the higher street or school ground above the valley that your household will move to when storm run-off rises, and go when heavy rain sets in on the hills; leave a house at once when cracks open in the cut behind it. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi na kufanya biashara hapa, ni vyema kuweka mitaro wazi na kujenga mbali na sakafu za mabonde na miinuko mikali. Kinachoongeza hatari: kujenga kwenye sakafu za mabonde au chini ya miteremko iliyochongwa, kujaza mitaro na mkondo wa bahari taka, na kuchonga vilima kwa viwanja vipya. Fahamu mtaa wa juu au uwanja wa shule juu ya bonde ambao kaya yako itahamia maji ya dhoruba yanapopanda, na nendeni huko mvua kubwa inapoanza milimani; tokeni nyumbani mara moja nyufa zikifunguka kwenye mwinuko nyuma yake. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.

C195.name: Mkoani District
C195.documented: large waves, strong winds, heavy rain, boat accidents, and cholera

area.sw: Mkoani: bandari na pwani ya kusini

risk.en: This area has the main ferry port and coastal villages where rough seas disrupt ferries and boats, and erosion and storm tides hit the shore.
risk.sw: Eneo hili lina bandari kuu ya meli na vijiji vya pwani ambapo bahari chafu huvuruga meli na vyombo, na mmomonyoko na mawimbi makubwa hupiga ufukwe.

advice.en: For those living, fishing and travelling here, it helps to travel only on licensed vessels in safe weather, wear life jackets and build back from the shore. What raises the risk: boarding overloaded or unlicensed boats, insisting on crossing when the port has suspended sailings, building on the eroding shore, and cutting mangroves. When a rough-sea or strong-wind warning is given, wait ashore even if it means a day's delay; know the higher ground inland that your household will move to when a storm-tide warning is given. Agree who will help anyone in the household who cannot move, see or hear a warning on their own.
advice.sw: Kwa wanaoishi, kuvua na kusafiri hapa, ni vyema kusafiri kwa vyombo vyenye leseni katika hali salama ya hewa tu, kuvaa maboya ya kujiokoa na kujenga mbali na ufukwe. Kinachoongeza hatari: kupanda vyombo vilivyojaa kupita kiasi au visivyo na leseni, kung'ang'ania kuvuka bandari ikiwa imesimamisha safari, kujenga kwenye ufukwe unaomomonyoka, na kukata mikoko. Tahadhari ya bahari chafu au upepo mkali ikitolewa, subirini ufukweni hata kama ni kuchelewa kwa siku moja; fahamu eneo la juu la ndani ambalo kaya yako itahamia tahadhari ya mawimbi ya dhoruba inapotolewa. Kubalianeni nani atamsaidia yeyote katika kaya asiyeweza kuondoka, kuona au kusikia tahadhari peke yake.
